_meta.title: England & Wales: arrests by ethnicity, by police force area, 2020/21-2025/26
_meta.measures: How many people of each ethnic group police arrested per 1,000 residents, and how many times the white rate (disparity). 1 = same as white people.
_meta.value: value = black_disparity_vs_white in the latest year shown
_meta.source: Home Office, Police powers and procedures: Stop and search, arrests and mental health detentions, England and Wales, year ending 31 March 2026 (published 1 October 2026)

notes: City of London rates should be read with caution: low resident population, many visitors (Home Office).

Metropolitan Police changed record systems in November 2022; unknown self-defined ethnicity rose from 4% to 69% (2021/22-2023/24), then fell to 34%. Read Met figures for those years with caution (Home Office).
Derbyshire could not provide data for 2024/25 and 2025/26 (Home Office).
_meta.groups: Self-defined ethnicity: asian, black, mixed, other, white, not_stated (no rate for not_stated)
